body: Ken French Data Library (mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/data_library.html) - HTTP 200; CSV zips download directly (e.g. ftp/F-F_Research_Data_5_Factors_2x3_CSV.zip, F-F_Momentum_Factor_CSV.zip, Portfolios_Formed_on_ME_CSV.zip). Current files built from CRSP through Sep-2026. Monthly and annual factor returns from Jul-1926 (5-factor from Jul-1963), sorted portfolios on size, B/M, profitability, investment, momentum, industries; also international and emerging-market factor sets (India is inside EM). Jay Ritter IPO data (site.warrington.ufl.edu/ritter/ipo-data/) - IPO-Statistics.pdf (1.36MB, tables updated Feb-2026) with first-day returns, 3-yr buy-and-hold by sales, profitability, VC-backing, dual-class, price-to-sales; pdftotext extracts cleanly. Use these to compute base rates ourselves rather than quoting blog summaries. SPIVA site (spglobal.com) returns 403 to our IP - use search snippets / press.
title: Free academic base-rate data: Ken French data library and Jay Ritter IPO statistics (both downloadable)
